acceptance: CLI --poc executes run_poc on the declared manifest
report records oracle runner/tier/status and evidence
items.hypothesis: the benchmark CLI adapter passes --poc, but verify_repair.py calls verify_repair() without run_poc, so the oracle is never executed and the verifier fails closed
items.required_fix: wire the PoC runner into the CLI/module exchange and record the oracle evidence digest; never treat a declared path as an executed oracle
items.title: Oracle exchange: runner CLI --poc is not injected as run_poc

acceptance: stack-strcpy candidate target-scope passes with exchanged scope
scope evidence is in the report
items.hypothesis: runner metadata only carries the manifest symbol/name; the verifier cannot resolve it, so target-scope is not_run
items.required_fix: exchange the pipeline-resolved target scope (va/end/source) in the verifier metadata contract; fail closed if absent
items.title: Resolved target scope is not exchanged (symbol not turned into va/end)

acceptance: cave/insertion candidates replay from the declared plan
items.hypothesis: the verifier fails immediately when len(original) != len(candidate); guard candidates inject a cave and grow the binary, so they can never pass replay
items.required_fix: model a declared patch plan with actions/insertions/cave and replay it deterministically into the candidate bytes; keep byte-replay as a special case
items.title: Resized/cave candidates are rejected by rewrite-only action replay

acceptance: associated changes are declared with kinds/scopes/hashes
verifier replays them and applies an explicit scope rule
undeclared out-of-scope actions still fail closed
items.hypothesis: the capacity engine emits a message_actions associated change outside report.actions; the pipeline gate passes because it checks actions/site_va, while the verifier recomputes the raw diff and rejects the out-of-scope action
items.required_fix: declare associated changes in the outcome/plan contract and model/allow them explicitly inside the declared scope; never silently widen or bypass target scope
items.title: Associated .rodata message action is not modeled; gate target-scope only sees report.actions

acceptance: ABI check runs on a derived block
items.hypothesis: the verifier only accepts metadata.abi_block; the runner and pipeline never derive/pass it, so ABI is always not_run
items.required_fix: derive ABI evidence from the patched function (block, arch, ABI id) and exchange it; keep the verifier authoritative
items.title: ABI evidence is not derived or exchanged

evidence_refs: verifier checks have no plan check
items.hypothesis: the outcome contains actions but no versioned patch plan and the verifier has no plan check; resized/associated changes cannot be exchanged structurally
items.required_fix: add a patch-plan contract (plan id/version, original/target hashes, actions, associated changes, cave/insertion ranges) and require it in the verification contract
items.title: Patch-plan contract is missing

items.hypothesis: the runner passes candidate bytes through a temporary file to the verifier and unlinks it; results.json stores only hashes and counters, so the disagreement is not reproducible from the artifact
items.required_fix: write candidate bytes, plan, metadata and verifier report into the disagreement artifact and exchange them by hash
items.title: Runner does not save/exchange candidate bytes, plan or verifier report

limitations: measured on the current host; dynamic oracle status is host-dependent and recorded, never faked
the candidate bytes are evidence-only and are not a correctness claim
